question: When did the Reserve Bank of India make its first repo rate cut since May 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**February 2025**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• The **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)**, in its **Monetary Policy Committee (MPC)** meeting held in **February 2025**, announced a reduction in the **policy repo rate** by **25 basis points (bps)**. 
• This policy move brought the **repo rate** down to **6.25%** from the previous level of **6.50%**, which had been maintained since **February 2023**. 
• This was the **first repo rate cut** implemented by the central bank since **May 2020**, when the rate was slashed to support the economy during the **COVID-19 pandemic**.
